name: maws
description: A macOS workstation for supervising Claude Code agent sessions

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --composite false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json --composite false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json --composite false
scripts.build:app: pnpm build:helper && electron-vite build && if [ -n "$MAWS_SIGN_IDENTITY" ]; then electron-builder --mac dir -c.mac.identity="$MAWS_SIGN_IDENTITY"; else CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir; fi
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm e2e && pnpm build:app && pnpm e2e:packaged && pnpm e2e:transcript && pnpm e2e:terminal && pnpm e2e:panel && pnpm e2e:c7 && pnpm e2e:voice && pnpm e2e:code && pnpm e2e:agents && pnpm e2e:widgets && pnpm e2e:settings && pnpm e2e:c12 && pnpm e2e:tools && pnpm e2e:side
scripts.e2e:transcript: MAWS_HARNESS=1 electron-vite build && MAWS_HARNESS=1 playwright test e2e/transcript.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:terminal: MAWS_HARNESS=1 electron-vite build && MAWS_HARNESS=1 playwright test e2e/terminal.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:panel: MAWS_HARNESS=1 electron-vite build && MAWS_HARNESS=1 playwright test e2e/panel.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:requests: MAWS_HARNESS=1 electron-vite build && MAWS_ENGINE_REPLAY=1 playwright test e2e/requests.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:composer: MAWS_HARNESS=1 electron-vite build && MAWS_ENGINE_REPLAY=1 playwright test e2e/composer.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:c7: MAWS_HARNESS=1 electron-vite build && MAWS_ENGINE_REPLAY=1 playwright test e2e/requests.spec.ts e2e/composer.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:voice: MAWS_HARNESS=1 electron-vite build && MAWS_ENGINE_REPLAY=1 playwright test e2e/voice.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:code: MAWS_HARNESS=1 electron-vite build && MAWS_HARNESS=1 playwright test e2e/code-tools.spec.ts e2e/code-editor.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:agents: MAWS_HARNESS=1 electron-vite build && MAWS_HARNESS=1 playwright test e2e/agent-tools.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:widgets: MAWS_HARNESS=1 electron-vite build && MAWS_ENGINE_REPLAY=1 playwright test e2e/widgets.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:settings: MAWS_HARNESS=1 electron-vite build && playwright test e2e/settings.spec.ts e2e/accounts.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:c12: electron-vite build && MAWS_C12_E2E=1 playwright test e2e/c12-budget.spec.ts e2e/c12-quit.spec.ts e2e/c12-sweep.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:tools: MAWS_HARNESS=1 electron-vite build && MAWS_HARNESS=1 playwright test e2e/maws-tools.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:side: MAWS_HARNESS=1 electron-vite build && MAWS_ENGINE_REPLAY=1 playwright test e2e/side.spec.ts
